context.0: Planet Mars has a reddish appearance caused by iron oxide on its surface.
context.1: The Mona Lisa is a famous portrait housed in the Louvre Museum in Paris. It was painted by the Italian artist Leonardo da Vinci.
context.2: The currency of Japan has a similar name as the Chinese yuan.
context.3: The Great Wall stretches over northern China and was built to protect against invasions.
context.4: In 1928, Alexander Fleming accidentally discovered penicillin when he noticed mold killing bacteria in a petri dish.
context.5: The speed of light in a vacuum is approximately 299,792 kilometers per second.
context.6: La plus grande ville du Brésil est São Paulo, tandis que Rio de Janeiro est une destination touristique majeure.
context.7: The Apollo 11 mission in 1969 landed astronauts on the Moon for the first time. Neil Armstrong became the first human to step on its surface.
context.8: The Earth's atmosphere contains nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide, and trace gases. Oxygen is essential for human respiration.
context.9: Die größte Stadt Kanadas ist Toronto, und zu seinen westlichen Provinzen gehören British Columbia und Alberta.
